Name: Redstranded Emily
Author: shalassa
Description:
This mods does what it says on the tin! It gives Emily a red strand in her hair.

Save to be added or removed at any time!

[b][u]Installation

[/u][/b]Just drop the mod into the Mods folder. Or use your favourite mod manager to do the work for you! (that's what they're good for, right?)


[u][b]Uninstallation[/b][/u]

Just delete the folder again. Or use your favourite mod manager to do the work for you!


[b][u]Compatability[/u][/b]

Incompatible with any other mods replacing Emily's portraits.
Possibly incompatible with mods adding events, if they add custom expressions or portraits.
